notes:
Venture 0.20 — the update installs itself

• Updating the controller from inside the app works. On a provisioned unit
  INSTALL did nothing at all: the kiosk refuses Android's installer dialog and
  says nothing about it, so the button looked dead. Venture now installs the
  update itself, with no dialog, and restarts on the new version.
• After an update the unit goes back to Venture on its own. Replacing the app
  cleared its claim on the home screen, so the controller came up on Android's
  "which app is Home?" chooser instead of the app.
• Updates have a page: Configuration > Controller > UPDATE. It says which
  version this controller runs, checks when you ask it to, and offers a newer
  one. Until now the only mention of an update was a panel at startup — before
  there is usually any network — and LATER dismissed it for good.
• The controller re-checks by itself whenever it gets a network, so joining
  Wi-Fi is enough to find out.

Getting TO 0.20 needs a cable. The fault this release fixes is in the version
you are running, so that version cannot install this one: a unit on 0.19 or
earlier has to be updated over USB or reprovisioned. From 0.20 onward the
in-app update works on its own.
